Class ApiKeyLoginMethod

java.lang.Object
org.jwcarman.who.apikey.ApiKeyLoginMethod
All Implemented Interfaces:
StatelessLoginMethod
public final class ApiKeyLoginMethod extends Object implements StatelessLoginMethod
API-key sign-in as a StatelessLoginMethod: adds the ApiKeyAuthenticationFilter as WhoApiKeySecurity.apiKey(ApiKeyAuthenticationFilter) does, and matches the requests the key would sign in: the header is present and not blank, and the request is not already signed in. A request already signed in from a session ignores the header, as ApiKeyAuthenticationConverter does, so the header does not exempt it from CSRF either. (On a WhoSecurity.stateless() chain no session signs the request in, so only another credential on the same request, such as a bearer token, makes the key ignored.)

    • carriesCredential

      public org.springframework.security.web.util.matcher.RequestMatcher carriesCredential()
      Description copied from interface: StatelessLoginMethod
      Matches the requests that carry this method's credential. Such requests are exempt from CSRF protection, so the matcher must match only when the credential is really there: a blank header must not match. Nor may a request already signed in, such as by a session cookie: its credential would not be what signs it in, so the cookie would ride along without a CSRF token.
      Specified by:
      carriesCredential in interface StatelessLoginMethod
      Returns:
      the matcher
